## Load input data

```{r, include = FALSE}
regulon_net <- params$regulon_net

models <- c("BLCA", "BRCA", "CESC","CRC", "GBM", "HNSC", "KIRC", "KIRP",
            "LIHC", "OV", "PAAD", "PRAD", "SKCM", "STAD", "THCA", "UCEC",
            "LUAD", "LUSC", "NSCLC")

# Read TCGA features -----------------------------------------------------------
## Features - TCGA
file_tcga_features <- file.path(params$easier_dir, "TCGA_expr_data.features.rds")
tcga_features <- readRDS(file_tcga_features)

# Compute TCGA-NSCLC features association with density of fibroblasts in tumor region -----
tcga_views <- tcga_features[c("pathway", "tf", "cellfrac")]

## Process data as in MOFA

# Pathways
tcga_views$pathway$NSCLC <-  rbind(tcga_views$pathway$LUAD, tcga_views$pathway$LUSC)

# Cell fractions
tcga_views$cellfrac$NSCLC <-  rbind(tcga_views$cellfrac$LUAD, tcga_views$cellfrac$LUSC)

tmp_cellfrac <- sapply(models, function(model){

  tmp_cellfrac <- tcga_views$cellfrac[[model]] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    # fix naming CD8
    dplyr::rename(`CD8 T` = `CD8+ T`) %>%
    # summarise Tregs and CD4, but keep treg estimate.
    # quanTIseq tends to over-estimate Tregs and under-estimate non-reg. CD4 Ts.
    as.matrix()

  tmp_cellfrac <- tmp_cellfrac[,!colnames(tmp_cellfrac) %in% c("Other", "DC", "Monocyte")]
  tmp_cellfrac <- log10(tmp_cellfrac * 100 + 0.001)

  return(tmp_cellfrac)

}, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

tcga_views$cellfrac <- tmp_cellfrac

# TFs
tcga_views$tf$NSCLC <-  rbind(tcga_views$tf$LUAD, tcga_views$tf$LUSC)


# Compute features bootstrapping mean and standard deviation -------------------

## original approach -

all_bootstrap_samples <- lapply(models, function(XX){
  get_bootstrap_samples(dir=params$features_dir, model = XX)
})
names(all_bootstrap_samples) <- models

# saveRDS(all_bootstrap_samples,
#         file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(regulon_net, "_TCGA_boot_samples.rds")))

mofa_boot_feature_stats <- lapply(models, function(model){

  mofa_boot_feature_stats <- lapply(1:100, function(run){

    sample_ids <- all_bootstrap_samples[[model]][[run]] # replacing was performed

    if (model == "NSCLC"){

      mofa_boot_feature_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("LUAD", "LUSC"), function(model_x){

        tmp <- cbind(tcga_views$pathway[[model_x]],
                     tcga_views$cellfrac[[model_x]],
                     tcga_views$tf[[model_x]])

        boot_id <- sapply(strsplit(sample_ids[[model_x]], split = "_"), head ,1)
        idx <- na.omit(match(boot_id, rownames(tmp)))

        tmp_df <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(tmp[idx,,drop=FALSE]))
        names(tmp_df) <- c("sample", "feature", "value")

        ## calculate mean, std
        mofa_boot_feature_stats <- tmp_df %>%
          dplyr::mutate(group = model_x) %>%
          dplyr::group_by(feature, group) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(feature_mean = mean(value),
                           feature_std = sd(value))

      }))

    } else{

      tmp <- cbind(tcga_views$pathway[[model]],
                   tcga_views$cellfrac[[model]],
                   tcga_views$tf[[model]])

      boot_id <- sapply(strsplit(sample_ids, split = "_"), head ,1)
      idx <- match(boot_id, rownames(tmp))

      tmp_df <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(tmp[idx,,drop=FALSE]))
      names(tmp_df) <- c("sample", "feature", "value")

      ## calculate mean, std
      mofa_boot_feature_stats <- tmp_df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(feature_mean = mean(value),
                         feature_std = sd(value))

    }

    return(mofa_boot_feature_stats)
  })

  return(mofa_boot_feature_stats)
})
names(mofa_boot_feature_stats) <- models
saveRDS(mofa_boot_feature_stats,
        file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(regulon_net, "_TCGA_boot_features_stats.rds")))

# Read TCGA MOFA bootstrap weights  --------------------------------------------

df_tcga_weights <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(model){
  mofa_boot_weights <- lapply(as.character(1:100), function(run){

    run_id <- paste0(paste(rep("0", 4-nchar(run)), collapse = ""), run)
    file_to_load <- file.path(params$mofa_dir, paste0(paste("mofa_boot", model, run_id, sep = "_"), ".hdf5"))

    boot_model <- MOFA2::load_model(file = file_to_load, load_data = TRUE)
    boot_weights <- MOFA2::get_weights(boot_model, scale = TRUE)

    return(boot_weights)
  })

  weights_df <- reshape2::melt(mofa_boot_weights)
  colnames(weights_df) <- c("feature", "factor", "weight", "view", "run")
  weights_df <- subset(weights_df, factor == "Factor1")
  weights_df$cancertype <- model

  weights_mat <- weights_df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = feature, names_from = "run", values_from = "weight") %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "feature") %>%
    as.matrix()

  ## Adjust sign of the factor 1 to have consistent + association with IR, across bootstrap runs
  ## Consistency across bootstrap runs: reverse sign of those negative correlated runs
  cor_1_vs_rest <- cor(weights_mat)[,1]
  if(any(sign(cor_1_vs_rest) == "-1")) {
    weights_mat[,sign(cor_1_vs_rest) == "-1"] <- - weights_mat[,sign(cor_1_vs_rest) == "-1"]
  }

  ## + association with IR (CD8 T cell best representative)
  if (sign(median(weights_mat["CD8 T",])) == "-1") weights_mat <- - weights_mat

  # quick check that most CD8 T runs are positive
  #apply(sign(weights_mat) == 1, 1, sum)["CD8 T"] # = 100
  weights_df$weight <- as.vector(weights_mat)

  return(weights_df)
}))

saveRDS(df_tcga_weights, file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "TCGA_boot_iHet_scaled_weights.rds"))

tcga_features$estimate$NSCLC <-  cbind(tcga_features$estimate$LUAD, tcga_features$estimate$LUSC)

res_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(cancer_type) {

  samples <- rownames(tcga_views$pathway[[cancer_type]])
  tumor_purity <- tcga_features$estimate[[cancer_type]][4, samples, drop=FALSE]
  tumor_purity <- as.data.frame(t(tumor_purity))
  colnames(tumor_purity) <- "tumor_purity"

  tumor_purity <- tumor_purity %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "pat_id")

  my_data <- cbind(tcga_views$cellfrac[[cancer_type]],
                   tcga_views$pathway[[cancer_type]],
                   tcga_views$tf[[cancer_type]])

  my_data_df <- my_data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "pat_id")

  features <- colnames(my_data_df)[2:ncol(my_data_df)]

  my_data.df <- plyr::join(my_data_df, tumor_purity)
  my_data.df <- my_data.df %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "pat_id")

  res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(features, function(my_feature){
    #cat(my_feature, "\n")
    res_cor_test <- cor.test(my_data.df[,my_feature], my_data.df$tumor_purity, method = "spearman")
    res_summary <- data.frame(cor=res_cor_test$estimate,
                              p_val=res_cor_test$p.value,
                              feature=my_feature,
                              hif="tumor_purity",
                              method="spearman",
                              model=cancer_type)
  }))
  return(res)
}))

saveRDS(res_all,
        file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "TCGA_cor_features_ESTIMATE.rds"))

lapply(models, function(model){

  if (model == "NSCLC"){
    # NSCLC TCGA data
    tcga_features$count$NSCLC <- cbind(tcga_features$count$LUAD, tcga_features$count$LUSC)
    tcga_features$tpm$NSCLC <- cbind(tcga_features$tpm$LUAD, tcga_features$tpm$LUSC)
  }

  counts <- solve_annotation_issues(gene_expr = tcga_features$count[[model]])
  tpm <- solve_annotation_issues(gene_expr = tcga_features$tpm[[model]])

  all_dataset <- list(counts = counts, tpm = tpm)

  iHet_df <- compute_iHet(dataset = all_dataset,
                          model = model,
                          use_bootstrap_weights = TRUE,
                          method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev", "iHet_excl"),
                          scale_mofa_weights = TRUE,
                          regulon_net = regulon_net)

  if (model != "NSCLC") iHet_df$model <- model
  saveRDS(iHet_df, file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0("TCGA_", model, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

})
```

## Examine TCGA-NSCLC features across microenvironment subtypes (Bagaev et al.)

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 40}

input_features <- as.matrix(my_NSCLC_data$NSCLC)

## Correlation TCGA features with fibroblast density (NSCLC)
### Filter for FDR <= 0.05 & corr > 0)
feat_pos_cor_hif <- feat_cor_hifs %>%
  group_by(feature, hif) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05 && cor > 0)

yes_hif <- unique(feat_pos_cor_hif$feature)
not_hif <- setdiff(colnames(input_features), unique(feat_pos_cor_hif$feature))

# Change patient id -
patients <- substr(rownames(input_features), 1 ,12)
patients <- gsub(".", "-", patients, fixed = TRUE)
rownames(input_features) <- patients
features_df <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(input_features))
colnames(features_df) <- c("patient", "variable", "value")

# Add bagaev info
features_df_mfp <- inner_join(tcga_bagaev_mfp, features_df, by = "patient")

# Add view information
features_df_mfp$view <- "TFs"
features_df_mfp$view[features_df_mfp$variable %in% colnames(tmp_pathways)] <- "Pathways"
features_df_mfp$view[features_df_mfp$variable %in% colnames(tmp_cellfrac)] <- "Cell fractions"
features_df_mfp$variable <- as.character(features_df_mfp$variable)

# Keep only correlated features
features_df_mfp_main <- subset(features_df_mfp, variable %in% yes_hif)

# Calculate median feature values across patients
features_df_mfp_main_median <- features_df_mfp_main %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable, MFP, view) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_value = median(value))

# Sort molecular subtypes
features_df_mfp_main_median$MFP <- factor(features_df_mfp_main_median$MFP,
                                          levels = c("F", "IE/F", "D", "IE"))

## Quantitative evaluation HIF features (F>IE or IE/F>IE)
### Visualize the data ##
fibrotic <- filter(features_df_mfp_main, MFP %in% c("F"))
#hist(fibrotic$value)
enriched_fibrotic <- filter(features_df_mfp_main, MFP %in% c("IE/F"))
#hist(enriched_fibrotic$value)
enriched <- filter(features_df_mfp_main, MFP %in% c("IE"))
#hist(enriched$value)

# compute wilcoxon sum rank test for each variable
test <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(features_df_mfp_main$variable), function(x) {

  # consider only the data for that variable and separate R and NR
  tmp <- subset(features_df_mfp_main, variable == x & MFP %in% c("F", "IE/F", "IE"))
  # compute average
  tmp_mean <- tapply(tmp$value, tmp$MFP, mean)
  # compute wilcoxon sum rank test, effect size and sign
  stattest <- rstatix::wilcox_test(data = tmp, value ~ MFP, ref.group = "IE")
  effsize <- rstatix::wilcox_effsize(data = tmp, value ~ MFP, ref.group = "IE")
  signs <- c(sign(tmp_mean["F"] - tmp_mean["IE"]), sign(tmp_mean["IE/F"] - tmp_mean["IE"]))
  p_val <- stattest$p
  eff_size <- effsize$effsize
  # Summary
  tmp_df <- data.frame(
    datatype = unique(tmp$view),
    variable = x,
    comparison = paste0(stattest$group2,">",stattest$group1),
    p_val = p_val,
    eff_size = eff_size,
    sign = as.numeric(signs)
  )
  return(tmp_df)

}))

test$signedEffect <- test$eff_size * test$sign
test$threshold <- as.numeric(as.factor(test$p_val <= 0.05))
test$threshold <- factor(test$threshold,levels = c(1, 2),labels = c("notSign", "Sign"))

xminmax <- max(abs(test$eff_size))
xminmax <- xminmax + xminmax * 0.01
ymax <- max(-log10(test$p_val))
ymax <- ymax + ymax * 0.01

# Add MOFA weight to df
mofa_nsclc_w_df <- df_tcga_weights_median %>%
  dplyr::filter(cancertype == "NSCLC") %>%
  dplyr::rename('variable' = 'feature')

test_w_df <- dplyr::inner_join(mofa_nsclc_w_df, test, by = "variable")

## Heatmap: features across molecular subtypes ---------------------------------

## all features together ##

### sort features by median eff size, and then by view
tmp2 <- test_w_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable, view) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(eff_size_median = median(signedEffect)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(eff_size_median))

sort_features <- c(subset(tmp2, view == "Immune cells quantification")$variable,
                   subset(tmp2, view == "Pathway scores")$variable,
                   subset(tmp2, view == "Transcription factors")$variable)

# scale featuresa per subtype
features_df_mfp_main_median <- features_df_mfp_main_median %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_median_value = scale(median_value)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% sort_features) ## Discuss with Gregor why two TFs are missing in the MOFA models **

# Extract name significant features
significant_features <- unique(subset(test_w_df, threshold == "Sign" & sign == 1)$variable)
facet_features <- rep("plain", length(sort_features)); names(facet_features) <- rev(sort_features)
facet_features[significant_features] <- "bold"

features_df_mfp_main_median$variable <- factor(features_df_mfp_main_median$variable,
                                               levels = rev(sort_features))
features_df_mfp_main_median$MFP <- factor(features_df_mfp_main_median$MFP,
                                               levels = c("IE/F", "F", "IE", "D"))

gg_all <- features_df_mfp_main_median %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=MFP, y=variable, fill = scaled_median_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_distiller(palette="RdBu", direction=-1, name = "Z-score \n",
                                guide = guide_colorbar(label = TRUE,frame.colour = "black")) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=12, angle = 0, hjust=1, vjust= 0.5, color = "black"),
                 axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, angle = 0, color = "black", face = facet_features[rev(sort_features)]),
                 axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                 axis.title.y = element_blank(),
```

## iHet predictive power for ICB immunotherapy in NSCLC

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}

datasets_bulk <-c("mariathasan" = "BLCA",
                  "gideauslanderpd1" = "SKCM",
                  "kim" =  "STAD",
                  "jung" = "NSCLC")

dataset <- "jung"

# data
tmp <- import_dataset(dataset)
response <- tmp$response

## Compute iHet scores (using scaled weights) ----------------------------------

# get cancer type
model <- as.character(datasets_bulk[dataset])

all_dataset=tmp$all_dataset
nR <- table(response)["R"]
nNR <- table(response)["NR"]

counts <- all_dataset$counts[,names(response)]
tpm    <- all_dataset$tpm[,names(response)]

# To list
all_dataset <- list(counts = counts,
                    tpm = tpm)
# run iHet
iHet_df <- compute_iHet(dataset = all_dataset,
                        model = model, # specify cancer-type-specific MOFA model
                        use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE, # indicate if bootstrap models should be used
                        method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev"),
                        scale_mofa_weights = TRUE,
                        regulon_net = regulon_net)

iHet_df$dataset <- dataset
saveRDS(iHet_df, file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

## Plot ROC and PR curves ------------------------------------------------------

# Unknown histology, average LUAD and LUSC iHet scores is used
## normalize to -1,1
iHet_df_norm <- iHet_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(method, run) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_score = linear_func(score, "11")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient, method, run, dataset) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(score = mean(scaled_score))

# Filter for patients with available response
iHet_df_norm <- iHet_df_norm %>% filter(patient %in% names(response))

# Add info about other predictors:

## PD-L1 expression
pdl1_df <- reshape2::melt(all_dataset$tpm["CD274", , drop=FALSE])
colnames(pdl1_df) <- c("patient", "score")
pdl1_df <- pdl1_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method = "PDL1",
                dataset = "jung",
                run = "1") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, method, run, dataset, score)

## TMB
tmb_df <- reshape2::melt(tmp$TMB)
tmb_df <- tmb_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "patient") %>%
  dplyr::rename("score" = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method = "TMB",
                dataset = "jung",
                run = "1") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, method, run, dataset, score) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = as.numeric(score))

## ESTIMATE - Tumor purity
estimate <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(all_dataset$tpm, method = "estimate")

tumor_purity <- estimate[4, , drop=FALSE]
tumor_purity_df <- reshape2::melt(tumor_purity)
tumor_purity_df <- tumor_purity_df %>%
  dplyr::rename("score" = "value",
                "patient" = "variable",
                "method" = "cell_type") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method = "ESTIMATE",
                dataset = "jung",
                run = "1") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, method, run, dataset, score) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = -score)

iHet_df_norm <- rbind(iHet_df_norm, pdl1_df)
iHet_df_norm <- rbind(iHet_df_norm, tmb_df)
iHet_df_norm <- rbind(iHet_df_norm, tumor_purity_df)

## ROC curve
ROCcurve <- assess_predictive_performance(iHet=iHet_df_norm,
                                          response = response,
                                          use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE,
                                          method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev", "PDL1", "TMB", "ESTIMATE"),
                                          plot_roc=TRUE,
                                          metric="roc")

## PR curve
PRcurve <- assess_predictive_performance(iHet=iHet_df_norm,
                                         response = response,
                                         use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE,
                                         method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev", "PDL1", "TMB", "ESTIMATE"),
                                         plot_roc=TRUE,
                                         metric="precision_recall")

svglite(filename = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "Figure3B.svg"), width = 8, height = 8, fix_text_size = FALSE, scaling = 0.6)
ROCcurve
dev.off()

svglite(filename = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "Figure3C.svg"), width = 8, height = 8, fix_text_size = FALSE, scaling = 0.6)
PRcurve
dev.off()
```

## iHet and iHet_rev predictive value in BLCA, SKCM, NSCLC and STAD

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, warning=FALSE}

datasets_bulk <-c("mariathasan" = "BLCA",
                  "gideauslanderpd1" = "SKCM",
                  "kim" =  "STAD",
                  "jung" = "NSCLC")

# Compute iHet scores ----------------------------------------------------------

lapply(names(datasets_bulk), function(dataset){

  # data
  tmp <- import_dataset(dataset)
  response <- tmp$response

  # get cancer type
  model <- as.character(datasets_bulk[dataset])

  all_dataset=tmp$all_dataset
  nR <- table(response)["R"]
  nNR <- table(response)["NR"]

  counts <- all_dataset$counts[,names(response)]
  tpm    <- all_dataset$tpm[,names(response)]

  if (dataset == "mariathasan"){
    counts <- solve_annotation_issues(gene_expr = counts)
    tpm <- solve_annotation_issues(gene_expr = tpm)
  }

  # To list
  all_dataset <- list(counts = counts,
                      tpm = tpm)
  # run iHet
  iHet_df <- compute_iHet(dataset = all_dataset,
                          model = model,
                          use_bootstrap_weights = TRUE,
                          method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev", "iHet_excl"),
                          scale_mofa_weights = TRUE,
                          regulon_net = regulon_net)

  iHet_df$dataset <- dataset

  saveRDS(iHet_df, file = file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

})

## Compute performance 1. AUC, 2.PR --------------------------------------------

## ROC performance ##
auc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(datasets_bulk), function(dataset){

      # data
      tmp <- import_dataset(dataset)
      response <- tmp$response

      if (dataset %in% c("mariathasan", "gideauslanderpd1", "kim", "jung")){

        # iHet scores
        iHet_df <- readRDS(file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

        # Unknown histology, average LUAD and LUSC iHet scores is used
        if (dataset %in% "jung") {

         iHet_df <- iHet_df %>%
            dplyr::group_by(method, run) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(scaled_score = linear_func(score, "11")) %>%
            dplyr::group_by(patient, method, run, dataset) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(score = mean(scaled_score))
        }
         # Remove model variable
        iHet_df$model <- NULL
      }

      # Filter for patients with available response
      iHet_df <- iHet_df %>% filter(patient %in% names(response))

      auc_df <- assess_predictive_performance(iHet=iHet_df,
                                              response = response,
                                              use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE,
                                              method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev"),
                                              plot_roc=FALSE,
                                              metric="roc") #roc, precision_recall

      nR <- table(response)["R"]
      nNR <- table(response)["NR"]
      auc_df$dataset <- paste0(dataset, "\n(R=", nR, "; NR=", nNR, ")")

      return(auc_df)
}))

## Boxplots, AUC distribution ---------------------------------------

# iHet vs iHet_inverted (iHet_rev)
auc_df$method <- factor(auc_df$method, levels = c("iHet", "iHet_rev"))

# Sort datasets
levels_datasets <- c("gideauslanderpd1\n(R=20; NR=30)", "mariathasan\n(R=25; NR=167)",
                     "kim\n(R=12; NR=33)", "jung\n(R=8; NR=19)")
auc_df$dataset <- factor(auc_df$dataset, levels = unique(levels_datasets))
new_labels <- c("SKCM-ICB\n  n=50","BLCA-ICB\n  n=192",
                "STAD-ICB\n  n=45", "NSCLC-ICB\n  n=27")

# Statistical test
stat.test <- auc_df %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(auc ~ method, ref.group = "iHet", paired = TRUE, alternative = "less") %>%
  add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "dataset")

col_method <- c("#7570B3","#D95F02")
names(col_method) <- c("iHet", "iHet_rev")

roc_perf_boxplot <- ggplot(auc_df, aes(x=dataset, y=auc)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = method)) + #geom_sina(alpha=0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= new_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_method) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", angle = 0, vjust = .5),
    legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC)", fill = "Method")

roc_perf_boxplot <- roc_perf_boxplot +
   geom_signif(stat = "identity",
               data=data.frame(x=c(0.775, 1.75, 2.775, 3.775), xend=c(1.225, 2.225, 3.225, 4.225),
                              y=c(0.8, 0.7, 0.7, 0.8)),
              aes(x=x,xend=xend, y=y, yend=y, annotation = "")) +
  geom_text(data=data.frame(x=c(1, 2, 3, 4), y=c(0.83, 0.73, 0.73, 0.83)),
            aes(x = x, y=y, label = stat.test$p.signif))

roc_perf_boxplot
ggplot2::ggsave(filename = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "Figure3E.svg"), width = 7, height = 8, device = "svg")

## PR performance ##
auc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(datasets_bulk), function(dataset){

      # data
      tmp <- import_dataset(dataset)
      response <- tmp$response

      if (dataset %in% c("mariathasan", "gideauslanderpd1", "kim", "jung")){

        # iHet scores
        iHet_df <- readRDS(file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

        # Unknown histology, average LUAD and LUSC iHet scores is used
        if (dataset %in% "jung") {

         iHet_df <- iHet_df %>%
            dplyr::group_by(method, run) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(scaled_score = linear_func(score, "11")) %>%
            dplyr::group_by(patient, method, run, dataset) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(score = mean(scaled_score))
        }
         # Remove model variable
        iHet_df$model <- NULL
      }

      # Filter for patients with available response
      iHet_df <- iHet_df %>% filter(patient %in% names(response))

      auc_df <- assess_predictive_performance(iHet=iHet_df,
                                              response = response,
                                              use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE,
                                              method = c("iHet", "iHet_rev"),
                                              plot_roc=FALSE,
                                              metric="precision_recall") #roc, precision_recall

      nR <- table(response)["R"]
      nNR <- table(response)["NR"]
      auc_df$dataset <- paste0(dataset, "\n(R=", nR, "; NR=", nNR, ")")

      return(auc_df)
}))

## Boxplots, AUCPR distributions  ----------------------------------------------

# iHet vs iHet_inverted (iHet_rev)
auc_df$method <- factor(auc_df$method, levels = c("iHet", "iHet_rev"))

# Sort datasets
levels_datasets <- c("gideauslanderpd1\n(R=20; NR=30)", "mariathasan\n(R=25; NR=167)",
                     "kim\n(R=12; NR=33)", "jung\n(R=8; NR=19)")
auc_df$dataset <- factor(auc_df$dataset, levels = unique(levels_datasets))
new_labels <- c("SKCM-ICB\n  n=50","BLCA-ICB\n  n=192",
                "STAD-ICB\n  n=45", "NSCLC-ICB\n  n=27")

# Statistical test
stat.test <- auc_df %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(auc ~ method, ref.group = "iHet", paired = TRUE, alternative = "less") %>%
  add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "dataset")

col_method <- c("#7570B3","#D95F02")
names(col_method) <- c("iHet", "iHet_rev")

pr_perf_boxplot <- ggplot(auc_df, aes(x=dataset, y=auc)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = method)) + #geom_sina(alpha=0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= new_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_method) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", angle = 0, vjust = .5),
    legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Area Under Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC)", fill = "Method")

pr_perf_boxplot <- pr_perf_boxplot +
   geom_signif(stat = "identity",
               data=data.frame(x=c(0.775, 1.75, 2.775, 3.775), xend=c(1.225, 2.225, 3.225, 4.225),
                              y=c(0.8, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8)),
              aes(x=x,xend=xend, y=y, yend=y, annotation = "")) +
  geom_text(data=data.frame(x=c(1, 2, 3, 4), y=c(0.83, 0.33, 0.53, 0.83)),
            aes(x = x, y=y, label = stat.test$p.signif))

pr_perf_boxplot
ggplot2::ggsave(filename = file.path(params$artifact_dir, "Figure3F.svg"), width = 7, height = 8, device = "svg")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# iHet and iHet_rev classification and association with immune subtypes --------

## mariathasan -----------------------------------------------------------------
dataset <- "mariathasan"

# Load iHet scores
iHet_df <- readRDS(file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

# Add response

response <- tmp$all_dataset$clinical_response
response$patient <- rownames(response)
response <- response[, c("patient", "Best Confirmed Overall Response", "Immune phenotype")]
colnames(response) <- c("patient", "BCOR", "MFP")
iHet_df <- inner_join(iHet_df, response, by = "patient")
iHet_df$response <- gsub("CR|PR","R", iHet_df$BCOR)
iHet_df$response <- gsub("SD|PD","NR", iHet_df$response)

# calculate median score across runs
iHet_df_median <- iHet_df %>%
  group_by(patient, dataset, method, response, MFP) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_score = median(score))

# normalize to -1,1
iHet_df_median <- iHet_df_median %>%
  filter(method != "iHet_excl" & is.na(MFP) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(method, dataset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_median_score = linear_func(median_score, "11"))

iHet_df_rank_median <- iHet_df_median %>%
  group_by(method, dataset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank = rank(median_score), inv_rank = rank(-median_score))

iHet_df_rank_median$category <- as.numeric(cut_number(iHet_df_rank_median$inv_rank, 3))
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub(1, "Tertile 1", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub(2, "Tertile 2", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub(3, "Tertile 3", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- factor(iHet_df_rank_median$category,
                                        levels = c("Tertile 3", "Tertile 2", "Tertile 1"))

iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub("Tertile 1", "High resp", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub("Tertile 2", "Mid resp", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- gsub("Tertile 3", "Low resp", iHet_df_rank_median$category)
iHet_df_rank_median$category <- factor(iHet_df_rank_median$category, levels = c("Low resp", "Mid resp", "High resp"))

frac_pat_response <- iHet_df_rank_median %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method, response, category, MFP) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(counts = n()) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category, method, dataset) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(frac = counts/sum(counts))

conflicts_prefer(ggplot2::theme_minimal)

gg_mariathasan <- frac_pat_response %>%
  filter(is.na(MFP) == FALSE) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = category, y = counts, fill = MFP, label = counts)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(position = "stack", stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#64a860", "#9970c1","#b98d3e","#cc545e")) +
  geom_text(size = 3, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white") +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(response ~ method, labeller = as_labeller(c(NR="Non-responders", R="Responders", iHet = "iHet", iHet_rev="iHet_rev"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face ="plain"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain", angle = 0, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain", hjust = 1, angle = 0, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 14), legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  labs(y = "Number of patients", fill = "Cancer-immune phenotype")
```

## Integration with TMB

> Combining three aspects (presence and localization of immune response, and tumor antigenicity)

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# With available TMB
datasets_bulk <-c("mariathasan" = "BLCA",
                  "kim" =  "STAD",
                  "jung" = "NSCLC")

# normalization unit scale first
normalize = "01_first"

plots <- lapply(names(datasets_bulk), function(dataset){

    # data
    tmp <- import_dataset(dataset)
    response <- tmp$response

    # iHet scores
    iHet_df <- readRDS(file.path(params$artifact_dir, paste0(dataset, "_boot_iHet_scores.rds")))

    if (dataset %in% "jung") {

      iHet_df <- iHet_df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(method, run) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(scaled_score = linear_func(score, "11")) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(patient, method, run, dataset) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(score = mean(scaled_score))
    }

    # Immune Exclusion --
    ## all runs
    iHet_excl_df <- iHet_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(method == "iHet_excl") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient, dataset, method) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(score = -score)

    ## median
    iHet_excl_df_median <- iHet_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(method == "iHet_excl") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient, dataset, method) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(median_score = median(score))

    # iHet --
    ## all runs
    iHet_orig_df <- iHet_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(method == "iHet") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient, dataset, method)

    ## median
    iHet_orig_df_median <- iHet_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(method == "iHet") %>%
      group_by(patient, dataset, method) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(median_score = median(score))

    # data.frame
    ## all
    myscores_df <- rbind(iHet_orig_df, iHet_excl_df)
    myscores_df$dataset <- NULL
    myscores_df <- myscores_df %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "method", values_from = "score")

    ## median
    myscores_df_median <- data.frame(
      patient = as.character(iHet_excl_df_median$patient),
      iHet = iHet_orig_df_median$median_score,
      iHet_excl = - iHet_excl_df_median$median_score
    )

    # response to treatment
    response <- data.frame(response=tmp$response,
                           patient = names(tmp$response))

    ## all
    myscores_df <- dplyr::inner_join(myscores_df, response, by = "patient")
    if(anyNA(myscores_df$response)) myscores_df <- myscores_df[!is.na(myscores_df$response),]

    ## median
    myscores_df_median$response <- response[myscores_df_median$patient, "response"]
    if(anyNA(myscores_df_median$response)) {
      myscores_df_median <- myscores_df_median[!is.na(myscores_df_median$response),]
    }

    # TMB --
    TMB <- data.frame(TMB=tmp$TMB, patient = names(tmp$TMB))

    ## all
    myscores_df <- dplyr::inner_join(myscores_df, TMB, by = "patient")
    if(anyNA(myscores_df$TMB) & !all(is.na(myscores_df$TMB))) {
      myscores_df <- myscores_df[!is.na(myscores_df$TMB),]
    }

    ## median
    myscores_df_median$TMB <- TMB[myscores_df_median$patient, "TMB"]
    if(anyNA(myscores_df_median$TMB) & !all(is.na(myscores_df_median$TMB))) {
      myscores_df_median <- myscores_df_median[!is.na(myscores_df_median$TMB),]
    }

    n_NR <- table(myscores_df_median$response)["NR"]
    n_R  <- table(myscores_df_median$response)["R"]

    myscores_df_median$dataset <- paste0(dataset, " (NR=", n_NR, ", R=", n_R, ")")
    myscores_df$dataset <- paste0(dataset, " (NR=", n_NR, ", R=", n_R, ")")

    # Combine scores (-iHet_exclusion, iHet, TMB)

    if (!all(is.na(myscores_df$TMB))){

      ### bootstrap
      final.scores_all <- integrated_score(myscores_df,
                                           with_TMB = TRUE,
                                           normalize = normalize)

      ### median
      final.scores_median <- integrated_score(myscores_df_median,
                                              with_TMB = TRUE,
                                              normalize = normalize)

    }
    return(list(median=final.scores_median, bootstrap=final.scores_all))
})
names(plots) <- names(datasets_bulk)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
  dataset = all_dataset,
  model = "NSCLC",
  use_bootstrap_weights=TRUE,
  method = "iHet",
  scale_mofa_weights = TRUE,
  regulon_net = "collectri"
)
```
